sources.title: qwen3.5-flash model information
sources.evidence: Exact alias documentation states equivalence to the 2026-02-23 snapshot, sparse MoE with linear attention, text/image/video inputs, text output, function calling, and a 1,000,000-token context. This verifies documented specifications, not a live inference request.

sources.title: Model lifecycle and updates
sources.evidence: The official release tables explicitly list qwen3.5-flash and qwen3.5-flash-2026-02-23 on February 23, 2026 across Beijing, International, Global and EU scopes.

sources.title: Deep thinking
sources.evidence: The Qwen3.5 Commercial Edition section explicitly names the Flash alias and February 23 snapshot as hybrid-thinking models, enabled by default.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B model card
sources.evidence: Explicitly identifies Qwen3.5-Flash as the corresponding hosted version with additional production features. The Language Model subsection reports nominal 35B total and 3B activated parameters. The open checkpoint has Apache-2.0 licensing; that license is not assigned to the hosted alias.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-Flash
sources.evidence: Exact product page displays the Qwen3.5-Flash name, text/image/video input, text output, hybrid sparse-MoE architecture, function calling and one-million-token context.

sources.title: Qwen model series official repository
sources.evidence: The former Qwen3.5 repository redirects here. It identifies Qwen as developed by Alibaba Group and retains February 24, 2026 release news for the open 35B-A3B checkpoint, distinct from the hosted API release log.

name.note: Preserves the catalog's space-normalized spelling of the official Qwen3.5-Flash product name.

developer.note: Qwen is an Alibaba Group model series; the official model card supplies the explicit Flash relationship.

family.note: Official documentation places Flash within the Qwen3.5 series.

release_date.note: Earliest explicit hosted-release date found, corroborated across regional tables. This is not inferred from the snapshot suffix or the open checkpoint's February 24 announcement.

open_weights.note: Qwen explicitly identifies this API model as the hosted version of the linked released checkpoint. Open weights refers to that mapped model, not the service implementation.

license.note: License of the explicitly corresponding released checkpoint; hosted service terms remain separate.

parameters_b.note: Nominal language-decoder billions, inferred through Qwen's explicit hosted-counterpart mapping and documented unchanged snapshot. Not a complete hosted deployment count; requires the proposed language_decoder scope.

active_parameters_b.note: Nominal activated language-decoder billions through the same explicit mapping. Does not include a measured vision-processing contribution or imply an exact stored-tensor count.

architecture.note: Exact Flash documentation specifies sparse mixture-of-experts combined with linear attention; moe is the catalog's architecture category.

context_window.note: Explicit context-window token limit, separate from the smaller maximum input and output limits.

modalities.note: Exact alias capability tables list these three inputs and text-only output.

reasoning.note: Hybrid thinking is supported and enabled by default; it can be disabled.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicitly supported in the documented regions. Built-in tool availability varies by region.

description.value: Hosted Qwen3.5 vision-language model with text, image and video inputs, optional thinking, function calling and a one-million-token context window.
description.note: Replaces broad task positioning with exact, documented hosted capabilities.

patch.description: Hosted Qwen3.5 vision-language model with text, image and video inputs, optional thinking, function calling and a one-million-token context window.

sources.label: Qwen hosted-counterpart mapping and decoder specifications

patch.notes: 35B total and 3B active describe the language decoder of Qwen’s explicitly corresponding released model. The complete hosted deployment total is undisclosed. The documented alias maps to the 2026-02-23 snapshot. Open weights and Apache-2.0 refer to the corresponding checkpoint; hosted service terms are separate.

summary: Confirms the official hosted-checkpoint mapping and its open weights/Apache-2.0 license. Adds nominal 35B/3B language-decoder counts and documented MoE architecture. Release, context, modalities, reasoning and tools are independently checked; deployment-specific full tensor total remains undisclosed.
